architectureDecisions: Reuse-first selection: standalone gepa@d771eb21b5dd3228bc3f567293d2ccfc423fc900 behind a Python adapter; do not reimplement reflection, Pareto search, candidate lineage or optimizer checkpointing.
Do not require DSPy for a non-DSPy ExHarness program. Keep LangGraph as an alternative rather than replacing the existing durable continuation/store.
Use OpenHands SDK events through normalization when that runtime is selected; retain ExHarness attempt/provenance binding without introducing a second event bus.

LangMem schema extraction/consolidation is an optional proposal producer; defer mandatory dependency pending labeled-cohort comparison. Reflexion supplies a bounded feedback pattern, not a production executor.
GEPA search acceptance is not independent promotion; selected candidate crosses existing HOW evaluation and currentness gates with final holdout excluded from optimizer.
Enforce hard budget reservations at dispatch through the existing ledger; observed GEPA max_metric_calls stopper can overshoot a batch.
Implement only additive episode/context/response/outcome bindings and projections around existing mechanics. Existing researched tasks remain unchanged.
